chunks: Aban narrated from Al-Hasan Al-Sayqal, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who performs ẓihār against his wife.
He said: "Then he must offer expiation."
I said: "What if he has intercourse before he offers expiation?"
He said: "Then he has committed a violation of one of Allah's limits, so let him seek Allah's forgiveness and abstain until he offers expiation."

key_terms.حُدُودِ اللَّهِ: the divinely established limits of Allah
key_terms.يُظَاهِرُ: to perform ẓihār against one's wife

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man has intercourse with his wife before paying the expiation for ẓihār?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on ẓihār, stating that expiation is required for the man who declares it against his wife. If he has intercourse before completing the expiation, he has violated one of Allah's limits and must seek forgiveness and refrain until he fulfills the expiation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4832 - Aban narrated from Al-Hasan Al-Sayqal who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who performs ẓihar (a form of divorce by comparison) against his wife.
I asked: "What if he engages in intercourse with her before offering expiation?"
Imam (as) replied: "Then he has violated one of Allah's (swt) limits. He must seek Allah's (swt) forgiveness and abstain until he fulfills the expiation."
